classification.rationale: Heading 8201 covers pruners of any kind. Two-handed pruning shears, which include lopping shears, fall under subheading 8201.60. Ruling F82761 places two-handed hedge shears there, and L81405 places one-handed palm pruners in 8201.50. I took the ratchet mechanism to be a feature of the tool that doesn't change its classification. I did not run ruling_status separately. The in_force status comes from the cross_search results. I did not run hts_navigate to confirm the 10-digit line is a leaf.
